construction: Forty-eight complete painted running drawings, including twenty-two complete ImageGen-authored or edited continuity replacements. Actual selected artwork establishes the periodic hair/cloth path, material-specific braid bends and corrected boot exchange. No detached limbs, regional restoration, procedural deformation, blends, repeated endpoint or guide pixels enter production.
registration: Each full master uses observed face/model density and measured neck registration with the existing small phase-specific whole-body offset. Uniform whole-figure sampling and translation only. The circular waist buckle in frame 32 has a source-hash-bound reviewed observation because NCC matched a chest clasp; no anatomy, scale or artwork was changed by that metadata correction.
